top_categories.workout_context: Stellenbosch Cycle Tour's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Stellenbosch Cycle Tour's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before race day.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.

Road-specific control matters at Stellenbosch Cycle Tour. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 63 miles.
At Stellenbosch Cycle Tour, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Stellenbosch Cycle Tour. Train it until it feels boring.
63 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Stellenbosch Cycle Tour. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Stellenbosch Cycle Tour's mixed terrain actually does to you.

race_overlay.weather: Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Stellenbosch Cycle Tour. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Stellenbosch Cycle Tour's 63 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 63 miles of mixed terrain in Stellenbosch, Western Cape, South Africa.
